text:
lina-support: New inbound — user says they signed up and completed email + instant bank verification but didn't receive free-trial credits. acct_id: acct_01G9Z4XYZ, signup_at: 2025-11-03T14:22:10Z. PM type: instant_bank (Plaid), ip_country: US, email domain: gmail.com. Can payments check autogrant logs?

matt-payments: on it. can you paste the payment method id and any provider response you have? also did they try multiple PMs?

lina-support: PM id pm_ibl_9a8f, provider_response: {"plaid_status":"success","bank_country":"CA","last4":"6789"} — user says Plaid flow showed US bank name but plaid returned CA. they only added that one PM.

autogrant-bot: Autogrant attempt skipped for acct_01G9Z4XYZ: reason=pm_country_mismatch, pm_country=CA, ip_country=US, risk_score=16 (low), rule_trigger=bindb_country_mismatch.

matt-payments: ah ok. autogrant rule blocked due to BIN/country mismatch even though risk is low. pinging @sasha-risk for a quick override?

sasha-risk: taking a look. can we get the raw Plaid institution metadata and routing_number? suspect US subsidiary or cross-border routing. if it's a canadian institution routing, we should escalate to manual grant.

lina-support: pasted Plaid metadata: institution.name="Northshore Bank (US subsidiary)", institution.institution_id="ins_12345", routing_number="021000021", country="CA", metadata.note="US deposit routing provided via partner". user attached screenshot of Plaid UI showing "Northshore Bank (US)".

matt-payments: weird. Plaid payload has country=CA but routing_number is valid US ACH. on our side BIN lookup returned CA which triggered bindb rule. i'll perform manual grant and flag payments team to relax the rule for this institution after confirmation.

matt-payments: Manual grant applied: +$15 free-trial credit (grant_id: grant_2025_11_03_01). updated account metadata: trial_granted_by=matt-payments, trial_reason=manual_override_institution_verified. user notified.

user-jordan: confirmed — I see the credits now, thank you! UI shows balance +$15 and trial badge. :)

lina-support: marking resolved. follow-up: payments to add institution_id ins_12345 to BIN override list or update bindb mapping. created ticket PAY-4261.

sasha-risk: noted. we'll run a small audit for similar Plaid cases this week to avoid repeated manual grants.

matt-payments: thanks everyone. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
